message: [DRG-22] Tag v0.1.0. Repository scaffold, dependency tiers, LCL loader. No CI yet - that is sprint 3.
[DRG-24] Tag v0.2.0. Synthetic generator, CLI with run-all, config and logging. A clean clone now produces a full run with no dataset.
[DRG-30] CI is green and merging is now gated on it. Full pipeline on synthetic data, four minutes.
[DRG-1] Tag v0.3.0. Data contract, neighbourhood aggregation, quality checks, container images. Data foundations complete.
[DRG-39] Tag v0.4.0. Consumption analysis and the figure set. Every figure in the design document now regenerates from run-all.
[DRG-3] Tag v0.5.0. Feature engineering complete: calendar, cyclical, lags, rolling, weather, and the split contract.
[DRG-55] Tag v0.6.0. Baselines and the evaluation harness. Naive at 1.54 MAE is the bar everything else is measured against.
[DRG-59] Tag v0.7.0. XGBoost at 0.70 MAE, 0.986 R squared. Primary model selected.
[DRG-66] Tag v0.8.0. Model ladder complete including the deep models and the torch-free fallback. The fallback is automatic and reported.
[DRG-5] Tag v0.9.0. Stress detection: per-site thresholds, event detection, frequency and duration, alarm F1.
[DRG-6] Tag v1.0.0. Electrification scenarios complete, including the diversity result. First release that answers all four of the analytical proposal objectives.
[DRG-9] Tag v1.1.0. Replay engine and external feeds, both deterministic and both degrading gracefully.
[DRG-7] Tag v1.2.0. Sensitivity analysis. Objective 5 answered.
[DRG-8] Tag v1.3.0. SHAP explanations, global and stress-specific. Objective 6 answered.
[DRG-10] Tag v1.4.0. REST API with forecast, stress, scenario and explanation endpoints, all versioned.
[DRG-103] Hotfix: model version now on every API response, with a contract test across all routes.
[DRG-106] Tag v1.5.0. Model registry and promotion gate. From here, a model reaches the API by passing the gate rather than by being the most recent thing trained.
[DRG-110] Hotfix: dashboard cache key includes the full selection. The neighbourhood switch bug is fixed and covered.

CI now runs the full pipeline on synthetic data on every push, about seven minutes. Closing DRG-14 - eighteen months of engineering practice work, and the run-all decision from week three is still paying for itself.
[DRG-111] Tag v1.6.0. Azure infrastructure as Bicep, deployed to non-production. Twenty months on laptops is over.
[DRG-112] Tag v1.7.0. AML training job and the replay page. Managed endpoint is behind it.
